Assignment classifies the value with a four-arm chain that has no else and then reads `val` unconditionally, so any other value type -- a Command such as 20\mm -- raises UnboundLocalError and kills the export (FR14)
calc_trem_dur qualifies durval2type with xml_objs, which does not define it, so every counted tremolo raises AttributeError and is silently dropped from the export (FR14)
check_voices reads self.section where the field is self.sections, so a global section raises AttributeError on close and the voice merge below it is skipped (FR14)

        misc = self.score_info.find("miscellaneous")

known_fixes.why: identification children are an xs:sequence and creators/rights come before encoding, so they must be inserted, not appended (FR15)
header variables the schema does not model belong in <miscellaneous-field>, not as bare children of <identification> (FR15)
the document declares the version it is validated against (FR15)
the DOCTYPE must name the same version as the root element (FR15)
a note declares its voice before its type; new_unpitched_note had the two reversed (FR15)
<staff> comes before beam/notations/lyric in the note sequence and must be a positive integer; upstream appends it and writes an unresolved context identifier verbatim (FR15)
a clef's number attribute is a staff-number and must be a positive integer, not a context identifier (FR15)
